title: Qt: Ensure temp folder name for merge
description:
Refactoring for commit 1e0d117eb7ab1ce7f4ff8a4fd6dc2529634d7baa
broke Wireshark's Merge file functionality due to NULL temp folder
name.

Use g_get_tmp_dir() when global_capture_opts.temp_dir is NULL or
empty for the merge temp folder name.

Fixes #18011.

notes.body: Could we please try to use the Qt version of methods in Qt code and not add more glib code whichever not 100% cross-compatible sometimes? In this case QTemporaryFile is the right way to go.

The idea is, that we should try to use Qt as much as possible in the UI code, as there are other implications beyond the simple cross-plattform situation, that may play into account here. For instance the user may have set a special temp directory, which Qt may apply to, and we do not catch. 

In general, I would avoid implementing too much ourselves if there are better options out there. And in this case we are strictly on the area of Qt where a better option does exist (including proper and correct cleanup)
Better solution applied by merge of MR !6933
